title: No TUI: mimid-agent is the JMAP Chat bridge
description: Chosen by Mark 2026-10-18. mimid ships no UI. mimid-agent (.13) is the JMAP Chat <-> MIMI bridge: it keeps all MLS keys and plaintext on the device and serves standard plaintext JMAP Chat to any existing JMAP Chat client (e.g. crate-jmapchat-client, jmap-chat-js). The previously planned TUI is dropped. End-to-end encryption is preserved (no server-side gateway). Open for .13 planning: the agent's local endpoint transport — stock clients may need loopback HTTP/WebSocket with a local token rather than only a 0600 unix socket (decide then).
